candidates.change_summary: Changed the require to check that any caller (no restriction) can call by removing the owner equality, allowing anyone to call sendTo.
Invert the require to block the owner and allow only non-owners to call sendTo.
Insert an extra transfer so the function sends the amount twice to the receiver, changing post-call balances.
Replace transfer with a transfer to owner (self) instead of the specified receiver, altering observable transfer recipient.
